La pulpe du fruit, appliquée fraîche sur la plaie, arrête immédiatement le saignement et restaure 1 à 10 points de vie. Sa conservation est médiocre : la préparation doit être employée peu après la cueillette. Le Souffle-de-Feu convient donc particulièrement aux soins réalisés à proximité du lieu de récolte.

This fruit is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known in south-eastern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

Fresh fruit pulp applied to a wound stops bleeding immediately and restores 1–10 concussion hits. It keeps poorly and must be used shortly after harvesting. Firebreath is therefore especially useful when treatment is given close to the place where it was gathered.
